未读取2025年全年国民经济运行情况新闻发布会正文，2025年初步核算数的发布会口径未独立核验。
2024年初次发布（修订前）GDP数值及五经普修订幅度未取得正文，无法量化版本修订影响。
统计局未直接公布2025年GDP名义增速，报告中的约3.91%为本文基于两年初步核算现价总量复算值，非官方指标；隐含GDP平减指数亦为推算，未经官方文本核验。
两年现价数据虽同属初步核算版本，但2025年公报未说明是否再次追溯修订2024年基数，完全口径一致性缺少官方明示证据。

sections.heading: 一、结论摘要
sections.text:
gdp_current_price_preliminary 2024 1349084 亿元
Extracted from the cited annual GDP preliminary layout; current-price level and constant-price growth retain separate units. Publisher authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified.

gdp_current_price_preliminary 2025 1401879 亿元

gdp_real_growth_preliminary 2024 5.0 %
Extracted from the cited annual GDP preliminary layout; current-price level and constant-price growth retain separate units. Publisher authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified.

gdp_real_growth_preliminary 2025 5.0 %
Extracted from the cited annual GDP preliminary layout; current-price level and constant-price growth retain separate units. Publisher authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified.

gdp_current_price_percent_change 2025 3.91 %

以国家统计局两年《国民经济和社会发展统计公报》的“初步核算”口径为准：2024年全年GDP现价总量1349084亿元、实际同比增速5.0%；2025年分别为1401879亿元与5.0%。两年实际增速相同，现价增量52795亿元，用同口径现价复算的名义增速约3.91%，低于实际增速，差异反映GDP价格水平总体偏弱。由于本次未取得任何“最终核实”公告正文，全部结论仅适用于初步核算版本。

四个原始数值均实际读取自官方公报正文，已在表中按期间与版本列明。版本：两份公报均以“初步核算”表述，注释[1]注明“本公报中数据均为初步统计数”，属年度初步统计版本，非最终核实。单位与口径：现价总量单位为亿元，不含港澳台；实际增速为不变价同比（%）。

sections.heading: 三、名义增速复算：计算式、单位与期间
sections.text:
gdp_current_price_preliminary 2024 1349084 亿元
Extracted from the cited annual GDP preliminary layout; current-price level and constant-price growth retain separate units. Publisher authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified.

gdp_current_price_preliminary 2025 1401879 亿元
Extracted from the cited annual GDP preliminary layout; current-price level and constant-price growth retain separate units. Publisher authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified.

gdp_current_price_percent_change 2025 3.91 %
Calculated only from scoped primitive observations; source authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified. Display rounding does not replace the retained exact calculation.

计算式：（1401879亿元 − 1349084亿元）÷ 1349084亿元 × 100% = 52795 ÷ 1349084 × 100% ≈ 3.91%。期间：2025年全年相对2024年全年。单位：同量纲亿元相除，结果为百分数。限制：该值仅在同为初步核算、同为2026年公报所引用口径的两年数据间复算；统计局未直接公布该值，且全部为初步统计数，后续可能修订。

sections.heading: 四、实际增速与名义增速的区别
sections.text:
gdp_real_growth_preliminary 2024 5.0 %
Extracted from the cited annual GDP preliminary layout; current-price level and constant-price growth retain separate units. Publisher authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified.

gdp_real_growth_preliminary 2025 5.0 %
Extracted from the cited annual GDP preliminary layout; current-price level and constant-price growth retain separate units. Publisher authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified.

gdp_current_price_percent_change 2025 3.91 %
Calculated only from scoped primitive observations; source authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified. Display rounding does not replace the retained exact calculation.

实际增速按不变价格计算，只反映实物与服务数量的变化；名义增速按当期价格计价，同时包含数量与价格变动。两者约关系：名义增速 ≈ 实际增速 + GDP平减指数变化率。2025年名义增速约3.91%低于实际增速5.0%，意味着GDP价格水平同比走弱；按 (1+3.91%)÷(1+5.0%)−1 推算隐含平减指数约−1.05%，为本文推算值，非统计局公布数。

sections.heading: 五、版本与口径管理：不能将初步核算与最终核实混用
sections.text:
gdp_current_price_preliminary 2024 1349084 亿元
Extracted from the cited annual GDP preliminary layout; current-price level and constant-price growth retain separate units. Publisher authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified.

gdp_current_price_preliminary 2025 1401879 亿元
Extracted from the cited annual GDP preliminary layout; current-price level and constant-price growth retain separate units. Publisher authenticity and cross-version comparability are not certified.

中国年度GDP按“初步核算—初步核实—最终核实”分步修订。本次两份公报均为初步核算，其中2024年公报注释[2]明确：据第五次全国经济普查结果并同步实施城镇居民自有住房服务核算方法改革，对GDP等历史数据进行了修订。因此不能将2024年更早发布的初值或不同版本数据与2025年公报值混用；最终核实值本次未取得，列为缺口。
